brainlife.desc: BOLD fMRI run (4D NIfTI), task or rest, optionally with events, single-band reference and physiological recordings.
brainlife.name: neuro/func/task
brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Preprocessing with fMRIPrep or C-PAC, QC with MRIQC, and denoising. Task GLMs, pRF mapping and functional connectivity once preprocessed.

**Not for:** GLMs or connectivity on runs without the preprocessed tag. Task analyses when events are missing; use neuro/func/events.

**BIDS:** func/bold (equivalent), func/events (equivalent), func/sbref (equivalent), func/physio (equivalent)

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

**Apps:** Input to 37 Apps, output of 15 Apps.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.func.task.json

files.desc: Task events table (onset, duration, trial type).
JSON sidecar describing the events columns.
JSON sidecar of the single-band reference.
JSON sidecar of the physiological recordings.

identifying_risks: JSON metadata may hold acquisition dates, institution or device serials
Physiological recordings and task responses are participant-level signals
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 6: participant-level neurodata linkable through a code; no recognisable face at typical resolution.
sharing_cautions: Strip acquisition dates and device identifiers from metadata before sharing
tier_conditions: Tier 3 if metadata keeps acquisition dates or device serials
